request.prompt: Paint a new Age of Empires III unit portrait in exactly the painting style of the first two reference images (official Age of Empires III unit portraits): close-up of head and shoulders, the head large in the upper half, three-quarter view, smooth airbrushed painterly skin, simplified stylised forms and folds, soft warm key light, hand-painted video-game look, NOT a photograph. The third image is only a costume reference (a low-poly game model), not a style reference. Subject: a Joseon Korean musketeer (jochong soldier) of the late 16th century, a man of about 30 with masculine East Asian features, a short black moustache and goatee, calm determined look. He wears a black felt jeollip hat with a round dome crown and a wide flat brim, a bunch of red horsehair tassel falling from the top of the crown over its sides, a small brass knob on the very top; a white hemp coat with white sleeves, and over it a sleeveless vest (jeonbok) open at the front showing a white strip of the coat. The vest is one flat pure magenta colour (#FF00FF) with no shading. He holds a matchlock musket upright at his shoulder (dark wood stock, iron barrel). Background: flat pure green (#00FF00), nothing else. No text, no border.
